<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>সাব্বির গ্যাস হাউস – নিরাপদ গ্যাস, ফ্রি হোম ডেলিভারি</title>
<meta name="description" content="সাব্বির গ্যাস হাউস: এলপি গ্যাস সিলিন্ডার, গ্যাস স্টোভ, রেগুলেটর ও পাইপ। ২৪/৭ খোলা, হোম ডেলিভারি ফ্রি। কল: 01931786814">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+Bengali:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="maincss">
:root{--navy:#14246b;--blue:#1e63c6;--orange:#f26b1d;--red:#d62828;--bg:#ffffff;--soft:#f3f6fc;--ink:#142046;--mute:#5a6585;--line:#dde3f0;--card:#ffffff;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0d1430;--soft:#121b3d;--ink:#eef1fb;--mute:#a6b0d0;--line:#26315c;--card:#162049;--navy:#9db8ff}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0d1430;--soft:#121b3d;--ink:#eef1fb;--mute:#a6b0d0;--line:#26315c;--card:#162049;--navy:#9db8ff}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Noto Sans Bengali",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.65;font-size:17px}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:68px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:20px;color:var(--navy)}
.brand img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%}
nav{display:flex;gap:22px;margin-left:auto;font-weight:500}
nav a:hover{color:var(--orange)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 20px;font-weight:600;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:600}
.btn.o{background:var(--orange);color:#fff}.btn.o:hover{background:#d95a10}
.btn.n{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .btn.n{color:#0d1430}
.btn.l{border-color:var(--line);background:var(--card)}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0f1c5a,#1e63c6);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding-top:56px;padding-bottom:56px}
.tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--red);padding:3px 14px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,56px);line-height:1.2;margin:14px 0 12px}
.hero p{font-size:19px;max-width:30em;opacity:.95;margin:0 0 24px}
.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.shelf{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:260px}
.shelf svg{width:22%;max-width:96px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3))}
.trust{background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.trust .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:18px}
.trust div{font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.trust span{font-size:24px}
section{padding:60px 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px);color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.3}
.sub{color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 26px}
.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:24px}
.tabs button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);padding:8px 18px;border-radius:99px;font:inherit;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#0d1430}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px}
.card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pic{background:var(--soft);height:170px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pic svg{height:140px}
.info{padding:14px 16px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;flex:1}
.info h3{margin:0;font-size:18px}
.info small{color:var(--mute)}
.price{color:var(--orange);font-weight:700;margin-top:auto;padding-top:8px}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.row a{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:8px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.row .c{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .row .c{color:#0d1430}
.row .w{background:#1fa855;color:#fff}
.alt{background:var(--soft)}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;counter-reset:s}
.step{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;counter-increment:s}
.step:before{content:counter(s,bengali);display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
.step h3{margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--navy)}.step p{margin:0;color:var(--mute)}
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px 40px}
.why div{padding-left:16px;border-left:4px solid var(--orange)}
.why h3{margin:0;font-size:19px;color:var(--navy)}.why p{margin:2px 0 0;color:var(--mute)}
.brands{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.brands span{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);padding:10px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.contact{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .contact{background:#0a1030}
.contact h2{color:#fff}
.contact .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:center}
.contact .big{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,46px);font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 16px}
.contact form{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;display:grid;gap:10px}
input,select{width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:0;font:inherit;background:#fff;color:#142046}
footer{padding:22px 0 90px;text-align:center;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));display:none;gap:10px;z-index:30}
.fab a{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:24px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
@media (max-width:820px){
nav{display:none}.bar .btn{margin-left:auto;padding:9px 14px}
.hero .wrap,.contact .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.shelf{min-height:200px}
.trust .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.steps,.why{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.fab{display:flex}
section{padding:44px 0}
}

.heroimg{position:relative;animation:in .9s .35s both cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.heroimg img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:16px;border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.4);animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.heroimg:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 50%,transparent 60%);background-size:250% 100%;animation:shine 4.5s 1.5s infinite;pointer-events:none}
.badge{position:absolute;top:-14px;right:-8px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;z-index:2;animation:spin 6s linear infinite alternate}
.hero .tag,.hero h1,.hero p,.hero .cta{animation:in .7s both cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.hero h1{animation-delay:.1s}.hero p{animation-delay:.2s}.hero .cta{animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes shine{from{background-position:150% 0}to{background-position:-100% 0}}
@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(-6deg)}to{transform:rotate(6deg)}}
.pulse{animation:ring 2s infinite}
@keyframes ring{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(242,107,29,.7)}80%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(242,107,29,0)}}
.mq{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 0}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .mq{background:#0a1030}
.mq div{display:inline-flex;gap:40px;animation:mq 30s linear infinite;padding-left:40px}
.mq span{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em}.mq span:nth-child(odd){color:#ffb27d}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-33.33%)}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.card:hover .pic img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.pic{height:200px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .4s}
.row .c{border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:600;border-radius:8px;padding:9px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff}
.row .c:hover{background:#d95a10}.row .w{flex:0 0 46px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .row .w{color:#0d1430}
.deliv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:6px 18px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:26px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 18px;overflow:hidden}
.deliv img{width:120px;height:122px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;grid-row:span 2;animation:ride 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes ride{from{transform:translateX(-4px)}to{transform:translateX(8px)}}
.road{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 0 18px,transparent 18px 32px);background-size:64px 6px;animation:road 1s linear infinite}
@keyframes road{to{background-position:-32px 0}}
.deliv p{margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
.step{transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}.step:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(20,36,107,.15)}
.cartbtn{position:fixed;left:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:30;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-size:26px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.cartbtn b{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;min-width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:14px;place-items:center;padding:0 5px}
.bump{animation:bump .4s}@keyframes bump{40%{transform:scale(1.25)}}
dialog{border:0;border-radius:16px;padding:0;width:min(520px,94vw);max-height:90vh;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);overflow:auto}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(10,16,48,.6)}
dialog[open]{animation:in .3s both}
.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--card)}
.dh h2{margin:0;font-size:22px}.dh button{border:0;background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink);width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px}
#items{padding:12px 20px}.it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.it img{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}.it b{flex:1;font-weight:600;font-size:16px}
.qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.qty button{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
.empty{color:var(--mute);margin:8px 0}
dialog form{padding:4px 20px 20px;display:grid;gap:10px;background:none}
dialog input{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.pay{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}.okm{margin:0;background:var(--soft);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px}
#send:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.ordbox{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:10px}.ordbox p{margin:0;opacity:.9}
@media(max-width:820px){.deliv{grid-template-columns:90px 1fr}.deliv img{width:90px;height:92px}.fab{display:flex}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.gh{grid-column:1/-1;margin:18px 0 0;font-size:22px;color:var(--navy);border-left:5px solid var(--orange);padding-left:12px}.gh:first-child{margin-top:0}
.pic{height:auto;display:block}
.strip{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;height:210px}.strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.strip img{flex:0 0 100%;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;scroll-snap-align:center;background:#fff}
.card:hover .pic img{transform:none}
.thumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.thumbs button{width:44px;height:44px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:0;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden}.thumbs button.on{border-color:var(--orange)}
.thumbs button img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:none}
.thumbs span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.3}
.hrow{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding:4px 2px 14px;margin:0 -2px}
.hrow .card{flex:0 0 min(250px,78vw);scroll-snap-align:start}
.hrow .strip{height:170px}
.tabs button{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 18px}
.addr{margin:18px 0 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px}
.addr .btn.l{background:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.owner{background:var(--soft)}
.owner .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:34px;align-items:center}
.owner img{width:100%;border-radius:18px;border:4px solid var(--card);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(20,36,107,.2);aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.owner p{max-width:34em;margin:0 0 18px}
@media(max-width:820px){.owner .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;justify-items:center}.owner img{max-width:240px}.owner .cta{justify-content:center}}
.ic{display:inline-block;flex:none}.ic svg{width:26px;height:26px;display:block}
.help{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:auto;padding-top:10px;line-height:1.4}.help span:last-child{margin-left:4px}
.kg{display:inline-block;align-self:flex-start;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;padding:1px 12px;border-radius:99px;font-size:15px}
.price{margin-top:2px;padding-top:0}
.row{margin-top:12px}
.bi{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:6px}.bi .ic svg{width:34px;height:34px}
.deliv{grid-template-columns:240px 1fr}.deliv img{width:240px;height:240px;border-radius:14px;object-fit:cover;grid-row:span 2}
.deliv p{font-size:19px}
@media(max-width:820px){.deliv{grid-template-columns:1fr}.deliv img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1;grid-row:auto}}
.ctl{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ctl button{flex:1;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ctl button{color:#0d1430}
.ctl button[data-del]{flex:0 0 46px;background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.abar{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(86px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:40;width:min(580px,94vw);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;background:#14246b;color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font-size:15px}
.abar .st{opacity:.85;margin-right:auto}.abar button{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;color:#14246b}.abar .sv{background:var(--orange);color:#fff}
.ae{padding:14px 20px 20px;display:grid;gap:10px}.ae label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}.ctl2{display:flex;gap:8px}
.ths{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.th{position:relative;width:78px;height:78px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff}.th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.th button{position:absolute;top:-8px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;padding:0}.th .x{right:-8px}.th .s{left:-8px;background:#ffb703}
.th em{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;font-size:11px;text-align:center;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-style:normal;border-radius:0 0 7px 7px}
.addimg{width:78px;height:78px;border:2px dashed var(--line);border-radius:8px;display:grid!important;place-items:center;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--navy)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><div class="wrap bar">
<a class="brand" href="#top"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="সাব্বির গ্যাস হাউস লোগো"><span>সাব্বির গ্যাস হাউস</span></a>
<nav><a href="#products">পণ্য</a><a href="#order">অর্ডার পদ্ধতি</a><a href="#why">কেন আমরা</a><a href="#contact">যোগাযোগ</a></nav>
<button class="btn o" data-open>🛒 অর্ডার</button>
</div></header>

<main id="top">
<div class="hero"><div class="wrap">
<div>
<span class="tag">২৪/৭ খোলা</span>
<h1>নিরাপদ গ্যাস, নির্ভরযোগ্য সেবা</h1>
<p>এলপি গ্যাস সিলিন্ডার, গ্যাস স্টোভ ও সব আনুষঙ্গিক জিনিস। ফোন করুন, আমরা পৌঁছে দেব আপনার দরজায়, ডেলিভারি চার্জ ফ্রি।</p>
<div class="cta"><button class="btn o pulse" data-open>🛒 অর্ডার করুন</button><a class="btn l" style="color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);background:transparent" href="tel:01931786814">📞 কল করুন</a></div>
</div>
<div class="heroimg"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
